call_points.text: Management raised FY27 revenue growth guidance to nearly 35%, up from the 30% communicated in Q1.
Guidance for upcoming 3 to 4 years is pegged at 25% to 30% annual revenue growth.
Construction started on 13 acres (9+4) land, targeted to become operational by end of Q2 FY28.
Average machine realization increased to ₹20.36 lakh in Q2 FY27.
Management expects EBITDA margin to exceed 20% once 10,000 machines capacity and backward integration are achieved.
New capex will qualify for Vikshit Gujarat policy incentives including 25% capex subsidy and 7% interest subsidy.
Chhapra capacity expansion expected to become operational by Q2 FY28.
Average machine realization stood at around ₹20.36 lakh in H1 FY27.
Management expects 28% to 30% revenue growth in FY27 with stable to improving EBITDA margins.
Q4FY26 closing order book stood at ₹406 Cr, with total tender bids of ₹1,029 Cr.
Other expenses increased due to higher marketing, roadshows, and job work costs to meet production targets.
The company plans to fund the new capex through internal accruals, debt, and supplier credit without equity dilution.
Management expects to sustain growth momentum on a strong industry outlook and CNC demand, without giving a numeric target.
Order book was ~₹406 Cr at 31 March 2026, with defence bids of ₹376 Cr and total bids of ₹1,029 Cr.
Q4FY26 other expenses were higher due to operational expansion and execution-related costs.
The company describes itself as net debt negative, with promoter holding at 73.17% as on March 2026.

timeline.summary: Macpower CNC Machines submitted its annual promoter shareholding and zero-encumbrance declaration under Regulation 31(4) for FY26.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹100.29 Cr (+25.3% YoY), net profit ₹10.15 Cr (+18.0% YoY).
Macpower's Q4 & FY26 investor presentation showed FY26 revenue of ₹3,332 Mn; EBITDA of ₹539 Mn and PAT of ₹339 Mn; with an order book of ~₹406 Cr and ₹376 Cr of defence bids under evaluation.
Macpower CNC hosted its Q4 & FY26 earnings call on May 28, 2026, guiding for 28-30% revenue growth in FY27.
Macpower CNC raised FY27 revenue growth guidance to 30%+ on strong Q1FY27 performance and order book growth
Earnings call scheduled for 27 October 2026 at 3:00 pm IST.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹120.33 Cr (+40.4% YoY), net profit ₹13.47 Cr (+43.6% YoY).
Macpower CNC issued Q2FY27 presentation raising FY27 revenue growth guidance to +35% with an order book of ₹476 Cr.
In Q2FY27 concall, Macpower raised FY27 revenue growth guidance to ~35% and guided for 25-30% growth over the next 3-4 years.
